purpose: Archive the complete cold-reset comparison with verified compact evidence.

decision.reason: Large live-heap reduction with mixed timing and slightly higher peak RSS. Continue with a separate shared-exit experiment; no universal or overall superiority claim.

packing: Deterministic tar.gz archives retain original member bytes and paths. Source-tree identity inventories and all preparation/timing records remain included. A complete exporter log is added after completion.
